report:
Conclusion: I cannot identify any specific difference between Model B and Model A from this evidence.

Reasoning:
- The L2 norm table shows zeros for every layer/position, so the mean residual-stream activation difference is effectively zero everywhere.
- The logit-lens outputs are identical across all reported (layer,position) cells and consist of common small tokens; that pattern is consistent with either a zero difference vector or an insignificantly small/noisy one.
- The patchscope readouts show no divergent continuations.

Together these indicate no measurable, interpretable activation difference in this data, so there is no evidence to name a specific objective, domain, or behavioral change.
